'''Marranis''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="The Bounty Hunter">''[[The Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> located in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was seen stopping there for supplies following the [[evacuation of Yavin]]. Although unsuitable for a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] base, Solo and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] went out into the desert and were captured by [[Wraith (Marranis)|wraith]]s, energy-based [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifting lifeforms]]. While tracking down Solo, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Havet Storm]] both came to a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on Marranis and then went out into the desert to find Solo. They were both fooled by the wraiths into thinking they found him, while the real Solo was safe.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter" />
